MIZORAM PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION
TECHNICAL COMPETITIVE EXAMINATIONS FOR RECRUITMENT TO
JUNIOR ADMINISTRATIVE GRADE OF MIZORAM LEGAL SERVICE
and SENIOR GRADE OF MIZORAM LEGAL SERVICE
UNDER LAW & JUDICIAL DEPARTMENT. JULY, 2016
GENERAL KNOWLEDGE & APTITUDE TEST
Time Allowed : 2 hours
Full Marks : 100
Attempt all questions.
All questions carry equal marks of 1 each.

DIRECTIONS (Questions 81 – 85):  In this section, you are asked what should be done or what is
required in a given situation. You are to choose the best answer available, or what most generally
applies to the question.
81. It is good to know how to read or write in order to
(a) Communicate better
(b) Correspond by mail with friends and family
(c) Be able to read articles in magazines
(d) Perform better in tests
82. It is wise to secure valuables because
(a) It prevents deterioration
(b) No one will be able to steal them
(c) It increases their value
(d) Their value can be replaced

(a) Obsession
(b) Agoraphobia
(c) Hallucination
(d) Hydrophobia

(a) Someone who gets enough sleep and starts working early in the day will have a successful life
(b) Helps in reducing weight
(c) People behave properly
(d) Helps in maintaining good health

(a) Prices are likely to decline later
(b) The bankers want to make a lot of money while they can
(c) Gold is more expensive to buy
(d) Loans can be repaid with money which is worth less
